crossRefs.note: He said to them, “I am one hundred twenty years old today. I can no more go out and come in. Yahweh has said to me…
who may go out before them, and who may come in before them, and who may lead them out, and who may bring them in, that…
You know Abner the son of Ner. He came to deceive you, and to know your going out and your coming in, and to know all…
Now give me wisdom and knowledge, that I may go out and come in before this people; for who can judge this great people…
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

translations.web: You shall be blessed when you come in, and you shall be blessed when you go out.
translations.bsb: You will be blessed when you come in and blessed when you go out.
translations.kjv: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
translations.asv: Blessed shalt thou be when thou comest in, and blessed shalt thou be when thou goest out.
